files.name: FlintClearing.java

help: Dig a free flat cell beside us (feet+head) so collect flint can place its gravel; after flint NO_ROOM
lesson: Flint NO_ROOM repeats in tight underground spots. Walking to open ground and mining seen gravel both lost, so this tries making the room in place by digging one side cell, a few seconds of work, then hands back to the normal flint steps.
summary: flint_clearing: right after collect flint fails NO_ROOM, digs out one side cell (feet and head height) with a solid floor so the retry has a free flat spot, without walking away or switching methods
